items.title: Turing Pattern Bloom
items.basis: The roadmap mentions a Reaction–Diffusion module for Turing patterns. These patterns often exhibit complex, repeating structures reminiscent of biological forms or natural textures.
items.prompt: black and white flat 2D vector silhouettes of intricate, overlapping Turing pattern blooms, organic cellular structures with closed contours, large gaps, on white background
items.why_weird: Abstracting biological pattern formation (Turing) into static, non-biological, alien glyphs with strong negative space.

items.title: Glitch Accumulation Manifold
items.basis: The roadmap mentions 'Entropy mask + glitch accumulation'. This suggests a process of degradation and layering that could create complex, fractured shapes.
items.prompt: black and white flat 2D vector silhouettes of abstract, layered glitch accumulations, fractured closed contours with sharp edges, digital noise artifacts forming solid shapes, on white background
items.why_weird: Visualizing 'glitch' not as an error, but as a constructive force defining alien geometric forms.

items.title: Noise Field Incursion
items.basis: The repo discusses 'noise fields' and 'math texture synthesis'. This implies generating complex spatial data that could define boundaries.
items.prompt: black and white flat 2D vector silhouettes derived from dense mathematical noise fields, smooth closed contours emerging from chaotic textures, unsettling alien biomorphic shapes, on white background
items.why_weird: Treating abstract noise fields as a physical medium from which solid, closed geometric entities are carved out.

items.title: Prompt Compiler's Crystal
items.basis: The 'prompt compiler' suggests a system that translates complex settings into dense, potentially structured outputs. This can be imagined as a crystallization process.
items.prompt: black and white flat 2D vector silhouettes resembling faceted crystals, grown from algorithmic compilation, sharp internal edges and smooth outer closed contours, on white background
items.why_weird: Personifying the prompt compilation process as the genesis of crystalline, alien structures.

items.title: Provider Adapter's Interface
items.basis: The repo has 'provider adapters' for different AI art services. These could be visualized as complex, functional interfaces or gateways.
items.prompt: black and white flat 2D vector silhouettes of alien interface elements, structured geometric forms with interlocking closed contours, highly abstract and functional-looking, on white background
items.why_weird: Representing abstract software architecture (API adapters) as a physical, alien geometric language.

items.title: Masked Entropy Gate
items.basis: The 'entropy mask' concept suggests shaping randomness. Imagine this as a stencil for chaos, defining enclosed regions.
items.prompt: black and white flat 2D vector silhouettes of abstract gates or portals formed by masked entropy, clean geometric outlines against implied chaotic backgrounds, solid closed contours, on white background
items.why_weird: Using the idea of an entropy mask to create solid, defined shapes that suggest a barrier or gateway to the abstract.

items.title: Deterministic Cache Echo
items.basis: The 'deterministic cache' implies repeatable, structured generation. Imagine this as a form that leaves a repeatable imprint or echo.
items.prompt: black and white flat 2D vector silhouettes of interlocking, repeating alien sigils, derived from deterministic generation, precise closed contours forming complex patterns, on white background
items.why_weird: Visualizing the concept of 'deterministic caching' as the generation of identical, intricate alien emblems.

items.title: Local Math Texture Labyrinth
items.basis: The 'local math texture synth' is a core component. Imagine generated textures forming enclosed, labyrinthine paths.
items.prompt: black and white flat 2D vector silhouettes of abstract labyrinths and mazes, derived from mathematical textures, solid walls forming closed contours, intricate pathways, on white background
items.why_weird: Transforming a texture synthesis tool into a generator of solid, playable alien mazes.

items.title: Image-to-Image Anomaly
items.basis: The roadmap mentions an 'Init-image / img2img pipeline'. This can be interpreted as deforming and abstracting an input image into alien forms.
items.prompt: black and white flat 2D vector silhouettes of highly abstract, deconstructed forms that originated from an image, sharp closed contours breaking down familiar shapes, on white background
items.why_weird: Representing the img2img process as a form of alchemical transmutation, turning familiar shapes into alien glyphs.

items.title: Preset Entity Bloom
items.basis: The 'presets' feature suggests saved, reusable configurations, akin to pre-defined entities or blueprints.
items.prompt: black and white flat 2D vector silhouettes of complex, pre-defined alien glyphs, modular components fitting together, each a distinct closed contour, inspired by algorithmic presets, on white background
items.why_weird: Imagining saved 'presets' as generating unique, pre-fabricated alien entities or symbols.
